@everyone

Hopefully you are having a glorious weekend thus far! A juicy announcement to make it better....

We are very excited to bring back our NFT Staking program! 

This round will involve both Cornucopias Land NFTs and Custom Dome NFTs. We have decided to continue with the same stake pool system that we did for our first staking program where you delegate ADA to our stake pool and earn COPI by claiming through our partners at Drip Dropz. 

So, onward to the details on the rewards!

For this staking program, you will delegate your ADA and earn COPI based on your NFT holdings for that wallet. While you will receive ADA rewards for your delegated ADA, you will only receive COPI rewards for the qualified NFTs. An important change for this round is implementing an 18-epoch vesting period (~3 months) for claiming your COPI rewards. 

The land and dome rewards will be earned per epoch and are different amounts based on size and rarity. This staking program does favor users who stake earliest, with the most rewards being earned in epoch 450, so don’t waste any time! 

What are the requirements to earn on my land/dome NFTs?

To earn COPI on your land you must:
1) Have all land and dome NFTs in the wallet you plan to stake with
2) Use that same wallet and delegate a minimum of 250 ADA to our COPI stake pool
3) After 18 epochs have passed, claiming COPI from Drip Dropz will be available each epoch until epoch 512

In summary:


This is a staking program for Land and Custom Dome owners
,
Rewards available:
Rewarded ADA for delegated ADA
Rewarded COPI for NFTs that are within the delegation wallet
,
,
,
Minimum ADA delegation required to qualify for NFT rewards: 250
,
- IMPORTANT!!! The first rewards snapshot is epoch 450. Delegate before 450 to ensure you qualify for the first snapshot. We suggest delegating by epoch 447/448 
There is a reward decay rate. The sooner you delegate the better
,
Staking program duration: 36 epochs
,
Vesting: 18 epochs (3 months) after then unlock ongoing every epoch for 35 epochs
,
Rewards stacking: 8 epochs (best practice claim on the same day each month)
,

We have also put together a staking deck with visuals to help understand the details. As always please ask a mod or community for help if you do not understand something. (edited)

@everyone 

Cornucopians, 

With recent feedback around the new COPI NFT staking announcement and the confusion with DEGA stake pool ISPO rewards, we have worked with DEGA on refining the announcement so that it is better understood how this works and what you need to do.

This round will involve both Cornucopias Land NFTs and Custom Dome NFTs.

We have decided to continue with the same NFT Staking system that we did for our first program where you earn COPI by claiming through our partners at DripDropz.

So, onward to the details on the rewards! For this program, earn COPI based on your NFT holdings.

You will receive COPI rewards for qualified NFTs in your wallet. An important change for this round is implementing an 18-epoch vesting period (~3 months) for claiming your COPI rewards.

The land and dome rewards will be earned per epoch and are different amounts based on size and rarity. This staking program does favor users who stake earliest, with the most rewards being earned in epoch 450, so don’t waste any time!

What are the requirements to earn on my land/dome NFTs? To earn COPI on your land you must: 
1) Have all land and dome NFTs in the wallet you plan to stake with.
2) Use that same wallet and delegate 250 ADA to our COPI stake pool.

NOTE: You will not get more COPI for delegating more ADA. This program is based on your NFT holdings only.

3) After 18 epochs have passed, claiming COPI from DripDropz will be available each epoch until epoch 512.

NOTE: If you are worried about your DEGA ISPO rewards, simply continue delegating to that stake pool and create a NEW wallet and do the following:

Send 250ADA to that wallet
,
Move all land and dome NFTs to that wallet
,
Delegate the new wallet to the COPI stake pool
,



In summary:

This is an NFT program for Land and Custom Dome owners
,
Rewarded COPI for NFTs that are within the delegation wallet
,
250 ADA to qualify for NFT rewards
,


IMPORTANT!!! The first rewards snapshot is epoch 450. Delegate before 450 to ensure you qualify for the first snapshot. We suggest delegating by epoch 447/448

There is a reward decay rate. The sooner you delegate the better
,
Staking program duration: 36 epochs
,
Vesting: 18 epochs (3 months) after then unlock ongoing every epoch for 35 epochs
,
Rewards stacking: 8 epochs (best practice claim on the same day each month)
,
We have also put together a staking deck with visuals to help understand the details. As always please ask a mod or community for help if you do not understand something.
,
